records.title: Monitorability as a Free Gift: How RLVR Spontaneously Aligns Reasoning
records.reason: The study measures reasoning-trace monitorability after RLVR and training-time alignment; it provides no serving or inference-cost reduction method.

records.title: ChromBERT: A foundation model for learning interpretable representations for context-specific transcriptional regulatory networks
records.reason: ChromBERT models genomic ChIP-seq transcription-regulator tracks for biology tasks; it does not optimize LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Diffusion-based unsupervised distributed acoustic sensing for rail condition monitoring and degradation assessment
records.reason: The article applies diffusion reconstruction to distributed acoustic sensing for rail degradation monitoring; SSM/diffusion terminology is domain-specific, not LLM inference.

records.title: ZeroCoder: Can LLMs Improve Code Generation Without Ground-Truth Supervision?
records.reason: Abstract concerns RLVR training supervision for code generation, not deployed inference resource optimization.

records.title: Fundus-R1: Training a Fundus-Reading MLLM with Knowledge-Aware Reasoning on Public Data
records.reason: Abstract concerns a domain-specific fundus-reading MLLM training/reasoning study, not inference efficiency.
